current_events: Saudi Arabia launches 32 airstrikes in four governorates in Yemen against the Houthis
September 2026 Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launch missiles at the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Azraq, Jordan, reporting damage to maintenance facilities, deployment areas, and hangars. Jordan says its forces have intercepted 18 Iranian missiles, following United States strikes that destroyed five Iranian oil tankers
The state funeral of King Harald V takes place at the Oslo Cathedral in Oslo, Norway
Death and state funeral of Harald V
Hurricane Lowell makes landfall across the south shore of Kauai, Hawaii, U.S., including at a Sheraton resort, with the hotel's oceanfront restaurant reportedly destroyed
A train collides with a truck at a level crossing in Sokolniki Suche, Poland, killing one person and injuring 20 others
Fourteen people are killed and eleven others are injured in an explosion at a weapons depot in Sarmada, Syria

Five people are killed and 87 others are reported missing when a fire breaks out aboard a passenger ferry off Coron, Palawan, Philippines. The coast guard rescues 42 people from the vessel, which carried 117 passengers and 17 crew members
Two people are killed and extensive damage is caused after an explosion at a hydroelectric power station in Piotta, Ticino, Switzerland

Peninsular Spain records its hottest summer since the State Meteorological Agency's measurements began in 1961, with an average temperature of 24.5 °C (76.1 °F) and 61 heatwave days from June through August
The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration reports that the United States has experienced its hottest summer on record from June to August with a 23.6 °C (74.5 °F), surpassing the Dust Bowl

The International Atomic Energy Agency ends its investigation into Syria's nuclear activities after the new government granted inspectors access to nuclear sites. Its board terminates a 2011 resolution that found Syria in non-compliance with its nuclear safeguards obligations
Syria and weapons of mass destruction
The Metropolitan Police launch a criminal investigation into Reform UK over allegations that it broke foreign funding laws in the United Kingdom, following an investigation by Channel 4 News
